keyEvents.text: Brayann Pereira (West Bromwich Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Bolton Wanderers 0, West Bromwich Albion 1. Aune Heggebø (West Bromwich Albion) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Callum Styles with a cross.
Akin Famewo (Bolton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Chris Forino replaces Akin Famewo.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Sam Dalby replaces Theo Bair.
Second Half begins Bolton Wanderers 0, West Bromwich Albion 1.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Rúben Rodrigues replaces Xavier Simons.
Rabby Nzingoula (West Bromwich Albion) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Bolton Wanderers 1, West Bromwich Albion 1. Rúben Rodrigues (Bolton Wanderers) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Callum Styles (West Bromwich Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Jimmy-Jay Morgan replaces Kareem Tunde.
Goal! Bolton Wanderers 1, West Bromwich Albion 2. Felix Myhre (West Bromwich Albion) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Bolton Wanderers 1, West Bromwich Albion 3. Aune Heggebø (West Bromwich Albion) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the top left corner.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Barney Stewart replaces Aune Heggebø.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Nathaniel Phillips replaces Harry Whitwell.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Thierry Gale replaces Samuel Iling-Junior.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Max Lott replaces Gaizka Larrazabal.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Tammer Bany replaces Felix Myhre.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Conor Townsend replaces Rabby Nzingoula.
